prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_FT_catboost', seasonality_champion='NaiveSeasonal', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_FT_catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while also being the overall RMSE champion (17.01), making it the trend champion. NaiveSeasonal dominates seasonality capture (0.5515 correlation) despite poor overall RMSE. High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 148.77) and different early/late horizon specialists suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition structure while adapting to concept drift.
